title: A maximal SOHM is both a maximum of integrated information and a workspace

statements.text: The largest SOHM of a system computes a joint posterior over the smaller SOHMs within it. Maximal SOHMs may coincide with IIT's maximally irreducible conceptual structures and with global workspaces, while a larger and less irreducible complex that includes the frontal lobes may be needed for access and agentic control.

sources.quote: Maximal SOHMs may be coextensive with both maxima of integrated information (i.e., MICS) and global workspaces.
the largest SOHM of a system would generate a joint posterior (or estimate derived thereof) over all smaller SOHMs contained within its scope
